question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Some kinds of health crises does have political consequences.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb "**does**" with the plural noun "**crises**."
 
• The correct verb form to use with the plural noun "crises" is "**do**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**crises do have**," ensuring **grammatical correctness **and subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Some kinds of health **crises do**__ have political consequences."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "political consequences."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **4: "Some kinds of health,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
